name: coup-de-grace-prepare-4-declined-no-critical
notes: Coup de Grace (5qWWpkgQLl, NORM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 4, printed power 4): "Prepare 4. [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Coup de Grace was prepared, it gains critical 4. (If combat damage would be dealt by a source with critical 4, double that damage unless an opponent discards four cards.)" Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Same setup, but player 2 answers NO to 'Pay Prepare 4?': counters untouched, the intent is never tagged PREPARED, no critical 4 (no 'Discard 4' offer is made), 4 damage. Pins the optional (declinable) nature of the cost and that the rider is gated on actually paying it.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Coup de Grace was prepared, it gains critical 4.
